The Raptors defeated the Magic, 129-99 tonight in Toronto. Scottie Barnes finished with a team-high 28 points along with 6 rebounds and 4 assists for the Raptors, while RJ Barrett tallied 25 points, 9 rebounds and 6 assists in the game. Tristan da Silva recorded 20 points, 4 three pointers and 3 rebounds. The Raptors improve their record to 3-1 with the win, while the Magic fall to 1-3 for the season.
